title: Building in Azure Pipeline (Android resource linking failed)
symptom: When building a release version of AndroidAPS 2.8.2 in an Azure DevOps pipeline, the build fails during resource linking with AAPT2 errors reporting missing resources such as color/importListFileName and color/importListAdditionalInfo. Debug builds succeed, but release builds fail.
cause: The user was building the wrong APK variant; they were building the WearOS image instead of the full smartphone app. The release build failed because they used 'assembleRelease' instead of 'app:assembleFullRelease'.
fix: Specify the correct Gradle task 'app:assembleFullRelease' instead of 'assembleRelease' to build the full release APK. This resolved the linking problem.
evidence_quote: Update: Seems that i needed to specify app:assembleFullRelease instead of 'assembleRelease'. This solved the linking problem. I have now successfully build a release APK :)
